features.description: The package starts, reports its version, serves a health check on 127.0.0.1, and has one passing unittest smoke test.
GET / serves one HTML page with four tabs (Calculator, Graphs, Lists & Statistics, CAS) plus plain CSS and JS files, with no external resources and no build step.

POST /api/calc/evaluate takes {"expr":str,"mode":"rad"|"deg" (optional)} and answers {"expr","exact","decimal","complex","domain_error"} (complex and domain_error are null unless set). It parses + - * / ^, parentheses and implied multiplication. Decimals are strings with 12 significant digits and no trailing zeros.
Supports sin, cos, tan, asin, acos, atan, ln, log (base 10), sqrt, abs, n!, pi and e, with an angle mode of "rad" (the default) or "deg".

Non-real results return 200 with an exact form and a rectangular complex form {"real","imag"}. 200 with a domain_error only when the math has no value (1/0, 0/0). 400 for client mistakes: syntax, missing or invalid parameters, redefining a constant. An undefined name is a symbol (as on the TI-Nspire CAS); decimal is null while a free name remains.
Each successful evaluation is added to the history. `ans` recalls the last result.
`name:=expr` defines a variable and `f(x):=expr` defines a function; the evaluate response gives the defined value or body as exact. Both are usable in later expressions and can be listed.
The Calculator tab is wired to the calculator endpoints.

Variables, functions, lists and history are held in memory and written through atomically to a JSON file (--state PATH, default ./graphcalc_state.json), which is loaded again on startup. --in-memory turns off disk writes.

POST /api/graph/plot takes {"functions":{"f1".."f4":expr},"window":{"xmin","xmax","ymin","ymax"},"samples":int} and answers {"x":[numbers],"series":{"f1":{"color":"#rrggbb","y":[number|null]}}}. Non-real, infinite or nan y-values are null so the curve shows a gap.
POST /api/graph/window takes {"action":"zoom_in"|"zoom_out"|"pan"|"standard","factor","dx","dy","window"} and answers {"xmin","xmax","ymin","ymax"}; standard is -10..10 on both axes.

POST /api/graph/analyze takes {"operation":"value"|"zero"|"minimum"|"maximum"|"intersection","f":expr,"g":expr (intersection),"x" (value),"lower","upper"} and answers {"operation","x","y","domain_error"} with decimals of 12 significant digits.
POST /api/graph/table takes {"functions","start","step","rows"} and answers {"x":[str],"columns":{"f1":[str|null]}}.
The Graphs tab is wired to the graph endpoints and draws on the canvas.
Named lists that can be created, read, updated and deleted through /api/lists, and used in expressions.
POST /api/stats/onevar takes {"list":name} and answers n (integer) plus mean, median, sum, sx, sigma_x, min, q1, q3 and max, each {"exact","decimal"} (TI quartile method).

POST /api/stats/regression takes {"model":"linear"|"quadratic","x":[str],"y":[str]} and answers {"model","coefficients":{"a","b"[,"c"]},"r2","points":[[x,y]],"curve":[[x,y]]}. Coefficients and r2 are decimal strings with 12 significant digits.
The Lists & Statistics tab is wired to the list and statistics endpoints.
POST /api/cas/simplify, /expand and /factor take {"expr"} and answer {"result"} in exact form with ^ for powers.

POST /api/cas/derivative {"expr","var"}, /integral {"expr","var","lower","upper" (optional)} and /limit {"expr","var","point","dir" (optional)} answer {"result"}. lower, upper and point each accept a number or an expression string such as "pi" or "oo".
POST /api/cas/solve takes {"equation":"lhs=rhs" or an expression taken to equal 0,"var"} and answers {"solutions":[str]} in exact form.
The CAS tab is wired to every CAS endpoint.
